```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(here)

```

Na BOP do XPERT é possível recuparar uma lista de moldes por peça

```{r}

source("R/read-bop.R")
bop <- read_bop()

moldes <- 
  bop |> 
  select(molde = tool, item = part_number, machine) |> 
  distinct(item, molde, machine)


moldes <- 
  moldes |> 
  left_join(itens |> select(item = tetenr, desc), join_by(item))

moldes |> write_csv("moldes.csv")
moldes |> View()

itens |> filter(tetenr == 'I01716030001A') |> View()
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
